book.name: ṮIMUṮH̱AWUUS ’DE/
book.title: Gwo jin Ṯwa/a/ jin ’Kwar ma Buulus goma ṮIMUṮH̱AWUUS mo

content: Monthum jin Thumkunu mo gom Jwahaŋ ’Kwaniŋ Ḵaniisa mo
A’di ta gwo jin ta isiŋ gana/ be jin onu ki: Waḵki/ wathin ’deŋ kamu/ dina gwo ibwa mo mmomiiya ṯu’c jin miina jwahaŋ ’kwani mo tani a’di ona bwa ka ṯuca ’borga/ mo be.

Wathi/ gwanyjaḵa/ midi mii diki mii ta gi mii ’ba/ mo, dhali a’di midi mii ta ga ’bom jasi ’de/ mo, dhali a’di midi mii ta wathi/ jin min ma du ’tim mo, dhali a’di midi mii ḵu’th is ki ’cese/ ’cese/ mo dhali a’di midi mii diki lo’b is piti nycine/ mo, dhali a’di minu mii ta gu’b piti ŋal mo, dhali a’di midi mii ta gwocon ki gwocon mo mmoṯor gwo mo,

dhali a’di midi mii diki ’dish mo ma su is mo, dhali a’di midi mii diki mii mii ki ra’b mo hili a’di mina e mii ’thup̱a’thup̱ mo, dhali a’di midi mii diki wala le’d ki ṯas ṯas mo, dhali a’di midi mii diki ta aman/ena guurush mo si’da/.
A’di midi mii mish kuŋ gu’b piti dhu ki ’bore/ mo, mmodhu uc̱im piti mmo’dap̱a bora ’cesh mo mmociḵ gwo mo dhali mmotaḵa taḵ mo ka ris ’twaŋkal kuku/ mo.
Haali/ waḵki/ wathi/ diki mish kuŋ gu’b piti dhu ki ’bore/ mo tani ba ki jin ta’da ta mmina a’di mish ’kwaniŋ ḵaniisa ma Arumgimis dhu mo?

A’di midi mii diki ta wathi/ jin ta jin this mo jin daḵa bu’th gwo jin gamu is mo haali/ a’di midi ’taki se ki ’pura/ ’pura/ mo ki ’ba/ jin kara a’di ki ca mo, dhali biṯ mo e mo jin waḵu tap̱a ma ruma ’cesh mo.
Bahili a’di minu mii maŋ mo ki ’kwani kun ’kon ka pije/ mo haali/ a’di midi ’taki biṯ mo e mo jin waḵuwa waḵ mo dhali eya gume/ gi tap̱a ma ruma ’cesh mo.
Monthum jin Thumkunu mo gom Imanhila Hil mo goma Ḵaniisa mo

Wakan si’da/ ’kwani kun dhunu mo mmohil to ma ḵaniisa i e mo tani uni mini mii ḵa/aḵa/ mo, mmo’koki ta gi ’twa/ jin onu gwo isu/ mo, dhali mmo’koki jima su i ’twa/ mo, dhali mmo’koki pur bwa mo goma guurush mo.
Uni mini mii bu’th gwo jin c̱inu ki jim bag mo jin gamu is mo ki ’twa/ ma dun dhelelgam buni mo.
Dhali uni si’da/ minu mii nyo/i ṯwa/a/ mo. Dhali yan’ko’d waḵki/ uni nyo/u ki is buni mo ki uni ta uni kun dar gi mii ’ba/ mo tani dhalki uni mii to mo me’d uni kun cila to hil mo goma ḵaniisa mo.
Wakan si’da/ up̱ mini mii ḵa/aḵa/ mo, mmo’koki thutha thu’th ’pen mo, hili uni mini ta uni kun mini ’tima du mo, mmota uni isiŋ gana/ mo eya ris to ’baar mo be.
Dhalki uni kun cila to hil goma ḵaniisa mo ta gi up̱ jasi ’deṯe/ ’deṯe/ mo dhali dhalki uni mish uc̱im buni dhu mo dhali kuŋ gu’b buni ki ’bore/ mo.

Haali/ uni gwansan kun miiki to ki ’bore/ mo me’d uni gun cila to hil mo goma ḵaniisa mo tani uni gam ’twa/ maŋ mo gom miiŋ gana/ jin gama uniya du is mo gom is buni mo dhali si’da/ adhan mo jin wunu jwa i is mo e moŋgam gwo is mo, a’di jin diki’d eya Ḵrisṯẖos jin ta’da Yesus mo be.
Gwo jin C̱inu ki jim Bag mo gom ji Luŋ Bana mo
Aha/ ṯosha mmop̱u’dku/ i um ki ’dishe/ mo, hili aha/ ’kwarkina um gwo gwansan mo mmoye’th um sho’k mo.

Wakan, waḵki/ aha/ takina diiṯe/ mo tani um mini ’taki mish mo mo ki um ḵa ba/ mini ’taki mii mii ki is bum mo me’d uni kun ta kuŋ gu’b ma Arumgimis mo, a’di jin ta’da ḵaniisa jin ta ji ma Arumgimis jin di ki e mo, a’di jin ta’da atiŋkiliŋ mo dhala cur gi gwoŋ gana/ mo be.
Ka jiŋ gana/ ana pikina gwo mo gom a’di yansan jin ta dhan gwo jin c̱inu ki jim bag mo jin ta jim bana jin luŋa ana aluŋ mo:

content.text: A’di jin ṯorkunu eya tente/ mo e shuman is mo,
dhali a’di jin karkunu ki mo ma ḵar/e e Shi/in mo
dhali a’di jin p̱arkina iman’doyu gwo e mo
dhali a’di jin c̱ikunu gwo mo e bwaman kal gi ’kwaniny’cesh mo
dhali a’di jin gamkina ’kwani gwo is mo e mony’cesh mo
dhali a’di jin bu’thkunu bway momis mo e monyca mo.
